Sofia: Heads up — noticed a spike in ll_evals/rope_suite failures after yesterday's kernel-heuristic push for qwen-1.3. Fail rate went from ~0.7% -> ~4.9% on tail sequences (>1024). I can repro locally with a small runner, attaching profiler excerpt below.

Mike: Can you paste the profiler lines or the scheduler decision log? Is this purely a tiled-attn swap or did batching heuristics change too?

Sofia: It's the selector + tail batching behavior. Key log snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] selector: chosen=tiled_attn_v2 (score=0.87)
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] batching: tail_prefetch=enabled (threshold=0.7)
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] kv_cache: prewarm=false
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] perf: token_latency_p50=12.9ms p95=85.2ms
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] eval: ll_eval_failures=49/1000 (+4.2%)
```

Cheng: That selector picks a different RoPE scaling path (we added an alpha fudge for tiled_attn_v2). If tiled_attn switches in mid-sequence for tail batches we can get a RoPE/phase shift relative to the kv layout — effectively a head alignment mismatch. Could manifest as quality drift rather than pure perf.

AJ: We saw a smaller version of this on Mixtral when we enabled tile-prefetch + quant path. My suggestion: revert the heuristic in prod (force tiled_fallback), run a 10k-eval canary, then reintroduce with a gated kv prewarm and rope-scale table.

Eva: Opened internal issue R-4821 and kicked off a bisect job. Command I used: `./infra/run_bisect --model qwen-1.3 --variant=kernel-selector --eval-set=rope_suite --target=quality`

ci-bot: CI: bisect job queued (job id: 2468)

Sofia: Quick mitigation I can push to staging: force `kv_cache.prewarm=true` for tail batches and clamp rope_scale for tiled_attn_v2 to the previous linear table. Pushing patch now.

Mike: Also add an eval-harness assertion: if per-token logprob drops by >20% vs baseline across first 128 tokens after a kernel swap, fail early and capture KV dump.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: qwen-1.3 kernel-selector revert -> 5% at 2065432120

Sofia: Plan summary: 1) revert kernel heuristic in prod, 2) run 10k evals + smoke on canary, 3) iterate on rope_scale table + kv prewarm guard, 4) reopen kernel selector with gating only after eval parity. I'll update R-4821 with results and traces. :thumbsup:

Cheng: Adding the perf traces and a short repro script to the issue now. :eyes:
